objective: Auditar fisicamente SQL Server EDARSAHUB en modo estrictamente READ_ONLY para determinar si ya existen capacidades equivalentes a ProductionItem, ProductionStation, QualityStandard, QualityStandardVersion, Measurement, ProductionEvidence, QualityDecision, Rework, QualityOverride, Device y DeviceCalibration. Verificar tambien estructuras canonicas de Tablajeria y FechaOperacion. Clasificar posteriormente REUSE, EXTEND, CREATE, COLLISION o BLOCKER. Ningun CREATE queda autorizado por este job. No auto-advance a Gate5B.

queries.name: candidate_exact_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
WHERE LOWER(o.name) IN (
    'productionitem',
    'production_item',
    'productionstation',
    'production_station',
    'qualitystandard',
    'quality_standard',
    'qualitystandardversion',
    'quality_standard_version',
    'measurement',
    'measurements',
    'productionevidence',
    'production_evidence',
    'qualitydecision',
    'quality_decision',
    'rework',
    'qualityoverride',
    'quality_override',
    'device',
    'devices',
    'devicecalibration',
    'device_calibration'
)
ORDER BY o.type_desc, schema_name, object_name

queries.name: semantic_objects

FROM sys.objects o
WHERE
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%produccion%'

    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%medicion%'

    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%estacion%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%station%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%dispositivo%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%retrabajo%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rework%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%override%'

queries.name: semantic_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    t.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id = o.object_id
JOIN sys.types t
  ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE

    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%production%'

    OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%calidad%'

queries.name: semantic_foreign_keys
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(parent_obj.schema_id) AS parent_schema,
    parent_obj.name AS parent_object,
    fk.name AS foreign_key_name,
    COL_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id, fkc.parent_column_id) AS parent_column,
    SCHEMA_NAME(ref_obj.schema_id) AS referenced_schema,
    ref_obj.name AS referenced_object,
    COL_NAME(fkc.referenced_object_id, fkc.referenced_column_id) AS referenced_column
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
  ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.objects parent_obj
  ON parent_obj.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.objects ref_obj
  ON ref_obj.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
WHERE
       LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%produccion%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%production%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%calidad%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%tablaj%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%evidencia%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%evidence%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
    OR LOWER(parent_obj.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(ref_obj.name) LIKE '%produccion%'
    OR LOWER(ref_obj.name) LIKE '%production%'
    OR LOWER(ref_obj.name) LIKE '%calidad%'
    OR LOWER(ref_obj.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(ref_obj.name) LIKE '%tablaj%'
ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_object, foreign_key_name

queries.name: semantic_indexes
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.is_unique,
    i.is_primary_key,
    i.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.indexes i
  ON i.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE i.name IS NOT NULL
  AND (
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%produccion%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%production%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%calidad%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidencia%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidence%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%medicion%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%'
  )
ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, index_name

queries.name: semantic_module_definitions
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.sql_modules m
  ON m.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE
       LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%productionitem%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%production_item%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%qualitystandard%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%quality_standard%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%productionevidence%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%production_evidence%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%qualitydecision%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%quality_decision%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%rework%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%override%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%foto finish%'
    OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%parrilla%'
ORDER BY o.type_desc, schema_name, object_name
